experiment: Frozen group-level two-tone diagnostic; no recolor

group_membership.reason: group-two-tone-frozen-guard; group perimeter touches low-alpha pixels

analysis.core_edge_definition: 8-connected erosion interior: every 8-neighbor is inside the current solid achromatic group core; remainder is core edge. Diagnostic only.
analysis.official_guard_measure_definition: group_components builds the visual group mask from reconstructed component masks, but builds core_measure_mask from each member's original solid-achromatic core_mask. The current two-tone test samples raw source RGB on this core_measure_mask only. It includes any partial-alpha pixels that meet the alpha>=32 achromatic-core predicate; it excludes separately classified tonal attachments below alpha 32. It does not blend in MASTER pixels or aggregate per glyph. sRGB linear relative luminance is multiplied by 255; dark <=64 and light >=192; each fraction must be >=0.03.
analysis.alternate_measurement_note: Diagnostic only. No alternate result substitutes for or weakens the frozen guard.

frozen_guard_implementation.luminance: sRGB companding then linear Rec.709 weights 0.2126/0.7152/0.0722, multiplied by 255
frozen_guard_implementation.population: original solid-achromatic core pixels from all reconstructed glyphs in the group; raw source RGB, not alpha-composited
frozen_guard_implementation.aggregation: once over whole group; no per-component requirement
frozen_guard_implementation.AA_and_attachments: excluded from two-tone calculation; reconstructed tonal attachments only affect group mask/connectivity
frozen_guard_implementation.master_background: not used for two-tone; used separately for contrast ratio and exterior topology
frozen_guard_implementation.threshold_result: both dark fraction >= 0.03 and light fraction >= 0.03
frozen_guard_implementation.protected_neighborhood: not explicitly filtered from core_measure_mask; frozen chroma/AA contact is separately reported by group ring guard
